landmarks.name: greater trochanter lateral facet (gluteus medius insertion)
landmarks.notes: Measured from Visible Human Male geometry (DU segmentation, CC BY 4.0), on the trochanter proper -- vertices more than 45 mm lateral of the femoral head centre. A looser 15 mm cut put the anterior and superior facets on the femoral NECK instead, at x=18 mm, because the extreme in a direction lands on the medial edge of whatever region is searched. Added because the greater trochanter carries seven muscles attaching to different facets, which a single point could not serve.
